chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 428: Han Li Chases Down the Strange Man & Discovers the Sealing Spirit Pillar
chapter_meta_description: Han Li pursues and eliminates the strange man, claiming a mysterious scroll and a sinister skull. The team uncovers a legendary Sealing Spirit Pillar worth 6,000 spirit stones.
og_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality – Ch. 428
og_description: Han Li completes a lethal pursuit and returns to find a pillar that changes everything.
twitter_description: Han Li chases, kills, loots, and stumbles onto an ancient artifact worth thousands of spirit stones.

lore_anchors.definition: A rare breed of insect spirit beasts whose greed for metal and spiritual energy makes them both a deadly weapon and a logistical nightmare to control.
A mid-to-high-level technique where multiple flying swords are temporarily merged into a single weapon, sacrificing versatility for greatly enhanced speed and penetrative power.
A purpose-built, multi-material artifact used in ancient ruins to suppress formations or powerful entities, often signifying that the real treasure is what lies below.
A category of magic weapon from a forgotten era; they cannot be bodily refined like modern treasures, but they are vastly more powerful per unit of quality.

The third major realm of cultivation in the *RMJI* system; a cultivator at this stage possesses a solidified Golden Core, granting greatly enhanced lifespan, mana reserves, and the ability to wield true magic treasures.
A bowl-shaped magical tool controlled by Qu Hun; its nature and properties suggest a heavy, blunt-force attack style.
Han Li’s primary flying sword during this period, associated with his wood-attributed cultivation. It forms the core of his multiple-sword combat style.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn’t the strange man use his ghost heads to cover his retreat?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He did, but Han Li’s beetle swarm overwhelmed them so quickly they were forced to self-destruct, buying him only a fraction of a second.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Han Li hesitant about the ghost skull?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is clearly a sinister, demonic-path artifact with lingering baleful qi; while powerful, Han Li is wary of items that might conceal a trap, a soul imprint, or a karmic backlash.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is a ‘Sealing Spirit Pillar’ doing here?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is the final lock on the ruin’s deepest secret. Its presence indicates that the true objective of the expedition is probably not the pillar itself, but what lies beneath or behind it.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Han Li fuse his swords instead of using the beetle swarm to kill the man?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The swarm was slower and the man was outpacing Han Li. Sword fusion gave him the burst of speed needed to close the distance for a clean kill.
